name: kapso
label: Kapso
description: Send and receive WhatsApp messages, media, templates, and more using the Kapso WhatsApp API.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Kapso API key. You can obtain it from your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai).

send_text_message.label: Send Text Message
send_text_message.description: Send a text message via WhatsApp.

businessAccountId.label: Business Account ID
businessAccountId.description: Your WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID. Find it in your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai).

phoneNumberId.label: Phone Number
phoneNumberId.description: Select the WhatsApp phone number to send from.

to.label: Recipient Phone Number
to.description: The recipient's phone number in international format (e.g. 15551234567).

previewUrl.label: Preview URL
previewUrl.description: Whether to show a link preview if the message contains a URL.

send_text_message.afterResponse: const camel = (v) => Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(camel) : v && Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Object]' ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]) => [k.replace(/[\-_]([a-z0-9])/gi, (m, l) => l.toUpperCase()), camel(x)])) : v; return camel(response);

send_buttons.label: Send Button Message
send_buttons.description: Send an interactive button message via WhatsApp (up to 3 buttons).

businessAccountId.label: Business Account ID
businessAccountId.description: Your WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID. Find it in your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai).

phoneNumberId.label: Phone Number
phoneNumberId.description: Select the WhatsApp phone number to send from.

to.label: Recipient Phone Number
to.description: The recipient's phone number in international format (e.g. 15551234567).

bodyText.label: Body Text
bodyText.description: The message body displayed above the buttons.

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to 3 buttons, as a JSON array of {"id", "title"} (title max 20 characters).

footerText.label: Footer Text
footerText.description: Optional footer text displayed below the buttons.

send_buttons.beforeRequest: const i = request.body.interactive; i.action = { buttons: JSON.parse(inputs.buttons).map((b) => ({ type: 'reply', reply: { id: b.id, title: b.title } })) }; if (!inputs.footerText) delete i.footer; return request;
send_buttons.afterResponse: const camel = (v) => Array.isArray(v) ? v.map(camel) : v && Object.prototype.toString.call(v) === '[object Object]' ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]) => [k.replace(/[\-_]([a-z0-9])/gi, (m, l) => l.toUpperCase()), camel(x)])) : v; return camel(response);

send_list_message.label: Send List Message
send_list_message.description: Send an interactive list message via WhatsApp.

businessAccountId.label: Business Account ID
businessAccountId.description: Your WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID. Find it in your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai).

phoneNumberId.label: Phone Number
phoneNumberId.description: Select the WhatsApp phone number to send from.

to.label: Recipient Phone Number
to.description: The recipient's phone number in international format (e.g. 15551234567).

bodyText.label: Body Text
bodyText.description: The message body displayed above the list.

buttonText.label: Button Text
buttonText.description: The text on the button that opens the list (max 20 characters).

sections.label: Sections
sections.description: List sections, as a JSON array of {"title", "rows"}; each row needs id, title, and optionally description.

send_list_message.beforeRequest: const i = request.body.interactive; i.action = { button: inputs.buttonText, sections: JSON.parse(inputs.sections).map((s) => ({ ...(s.title ? { title: s.title } : {}), rows: (typeof s.rows === 'string' ? JSON.parse(s.rows) : s.rows).map((r) => ({ id: r.id, title: r.title, ...(r.description ? { description: r.description } : {}) })) })) }; if (inputs.headerText) i.header = { type: 'text', text: inputs.headerText }; if (!inputs.footerText) delete i.footer; return request;

Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(v).map(([k, x]) => [k.replace(/[\-_]([a-z0-9])/gi, (m, l) => l.toUpperCase()), camel(x)])) : v; return camel(response);

bodyParameters.label: Body Parameters
bodyParameters.description: Template body parameters, as a JSON array of {"parameterName", "text"}.

buttonParameters.label: Button Parameters
buttonParameters.description: Template button parameters, as a JSON array of {"subType" (quick_reply, url, otp or flow), "index", "value", "flowToken", "flowActionData"}.

new_message_received.label: New Message Received
new_message_received.description: Triggers when a new WhatsApp message is received. Copy the trigger's address into your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai) as the Webhook destination URL of your WhatsApp number.

message_status_update.label: Message Status Update
message_status_update.description: Triggers when a message status changes (sent, delivered, read). Copy the trigger's address into your [Kapso dashboard](https://app.kapso.ai) as the Webhook destination URL of your WhatsApp number.

statusFilter.label: Status Filter
statusFilter.description: Only trigger for a specific status. Leave as All to trigger for any status change.
